_help: Copy to data/post.json and edit for your post. Coordinates are fractions of the frame (0..1): fences are lines x1,y1,x2,y2 along the ground; restricted zones are rectangles x1,y1,x2,y2. Camera ids are the ones in app/config.py (CAMERAS / LIVE_SOURCES). learning_days: days before this post's own baseline is used (until then: borrow_baseline, a movements CSV from a post with similar traffic, relative to data/; or fence rules within the budget). baseline_days: refit window. retention: clip_days for alert clips that were not escalated, log_days for movement logs. hq_url: Sector HQ service (hq/server.py) for store-and-forward; empty = off.
